sections.why: Bright intriguing Up Happy starts cleanly past silence at 0:02.5 for the SMP mystery.
Cruel lava griefing + late-night IRL bedroom struggle switches smoothly to Up Sad.
Short emotional breath of silence as the Server Owner opens Milo's signed book and freezes.
Warm piano chord swells back under Milo's note.
Owner sends golden server alert (!) — Up Happy swells cleanly into the overnight build rally.
Lantern-lit Safe Booths, Iron Golems, floating hearts, bully apology, and subscribe CTA.
